_comment: The overlay's base image, read out of the container. verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/module-base-image.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: the window subtracts the header, as a body-holding backend would
trials.replace: return { baseImage, imageRead: (at, dest) => imageRead(at - 16, dest) };

trials.name: the lazy entries come back empty instead of from the container
the lazy half is read from the archive section
the deployment base is never applied, so a relative URL stays relative
the base is prepended to absolute and rooted URLs too
an archive rebases its transports but keeps its stale url
